history_rotation.rule: four A,B,C tuples assigned prospectively by seed mod 4

mode_measurement: top right singular vector of isolated x->m->x loop under the same seed-specific standardized audit noise reused at every generation

primary_hypotheses.H2_small_angular_displacement: mean sign-invariant angular displacement <2 degrees and bootstrap 95% upper bound <2.5 degrees
primary_hypotheses.H3_small_projector_displacement: mean Frobenius norm ||v_next v_next^T - v v^T||_F <0.05 and bootstrap upper bound <0.06
primary_hypotheses.H4_capacity_stability: mean absolute relative sigma1 change <0.05 and >90% transitions <0.10

interpretation_rule.all_pass: under neutral carrier evolution the optimal high-gain mode is effectively stationary; previously observed multigeneration failure is representational packet drift away from a stable mode, not substantial motion of the mode itself
interpretation_rule.fail_H1_or_H2: the diagnostic stationarity does not replicate and genuine mode transport remains open

scope_warning: stationarity only for this standardized neutral-evolution regime; does not rule out mode displacement under stronger contextual/history changes
